purpose: Stable discovery surface for operators, Thought Core, diagnostics, speech-input adapters, and visible-demo preflight helpers that need PC-output and microphone audio awareness without raw audio capture or transcript publication.

preconditions: contract, runtime builder, and example files are available
no runtime audio capture is being claimed
accept_result: pc_output and microphone channels remain separate

preconditions: legacy speech-input VAD result is already available as summary/debug metadata
no raw microphone audio is shared
STT and transcript publication remain separate
accept_result: legacy VAD checked/speech_detected fields map to a legacy_speech_input channel
speech_present is represented as summary metadata
raw audio and transcript flags remain false

routes.command_template: future-reviewed-route: emit audio_awareness_summary.json from an explicitly enabled PC-output adapter without raw audio persistence
preconditions: raw samples remain local and are not persisted
per-application source is not inferred from system mix without a separate event correlation
accept_result: pc_output channel reports audio_present or held with a concrete blocker
proof ceiling stays at PC-output summary layer

routes.command_template: future-reviewed-route: emit microphone summary only after explicit microphone capture permission
preconditions: microphone capture is explicitly authorized for the route
STT is not attempted unless a later route enables it
accept_result: microphone channel reports audio_present/speech_present or held with a concrete blocker
raw audio and full transcript flags remain false
proof ceiling stays at microphone summary layer

stop_conditions: the only available evidence requires raw audio, full transcripts, screenshots, private paths, provider payloads, or Home Assistant identifiers
a consumer tries to treat PC-output loopback as proof the user heard audio
a consumer tries to treat a TTS request as proof that audio played
a consumer tries to infer per-application audio source from system-mix energy alone
microphone capture would occur without an explicit route permission
STT or provider/network processing would occur without a reviewed route

consumer_guidance.thought_core: Treat audio awareness as observation context only. It may help distinguish TTS request, playback call, PC-output energy, microphone pickup, and possible speaker bleed, but it is not action authority or user-intent proof by itself.
consumer_guidance.diagnostics: Read audio_awareness_summary.json for redacted channel summaries and status refs. Do not persist raw samples, full transcripts, private paths, screenshots, or provider payloads.
consumer_guidance.human_operator: Use this route map to understand which audio proof layer is available before a demo. User-heard audio remains an operator observation unless a later reviewed route adds stronger evidence.
consumer_guidance.speech_input_adapter: Map existing VAD/STT metadata into summary channels without changing legacy endpoints until the adapter migration is explicitly adopted.
consumer_guidance.visible_demo_preflight: Use source/static readiness rows first. Live PC-output or microphone checks need separate explicit route authority.
